summary: Document the fenced whole-Mac light-node cutover, rollback and settled CPU acceptance runbook

replay.detail: Documentation only; durable replay and custody behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: No protocol, storage or configuration changes.

rules.detail: No planner, executor or publication authority changes.

compatibility.detail: No deployment, caller routing or service activation is performed.

downtime.detail: This PR describes a separately approved cutover window; it does not execute one.

manual.detail: No operator action is required by this documentation change; the runbook explicitly gates future execution on supported tooling and approvals.

recovery.detail: Documents epoch-fenced rollback with a current authoritative graph decision cut, without implementing or exercising migration.
